questions.question: [Product Design and Development] Create a series of experimental studies exploring product design and development. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to product design and development, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.
questions.explanation: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to product design and development, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: [Product Design and Development] Research an artist or designer who works with product design and development. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.
questions.explanation: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: [Product Design and Development] Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with product design and development. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.
questions.explanation: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.
